comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Product confirmed the 48h rule should be retired; tracking config change plus a one-line bot update.

content.text: Product confirmed the 48h rule should be retired; tracking config change plus a one-line bot update.

Billing questions whose subject or category is seat reduction are auto-closed by the silence bot after 48 hours without a customer reply, even when an agent is waiting on finance approval and has posted an internal note. Other billing categories use the standard 7-day silence window.

Expected: seat-reduction questions follow the same 7-day policy as refund and invoice disputes, or at least respect snooze / waiting_on_internal. Actual: a dedicated rule seat_reduction_silence_hours=48 closes the ticket and sends a "we assume this is resolved" email.
That rule was a temporary measure during a pricing launch and was never removed. Customers re-open or file duplicates when finance finally answers.
